title: INTRODUCTION TO SYSTEMS PROGRAMMING
description: Explores systems-level programming using compiled languages such as C and C++. Explores terminals, shells, C and C++ syntax, pointers, memory models, and more. Learn to design and implement C and C++ programs, navigate language build pipelines, use terminals and shells, solve problems with different memory models, and manage dynamic memory. Gains practical skills for real-world coding challenges.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CS 162 or 162H.
A minimum grade of C is required in CS 162 and CS 162H.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Elect & Computer Engineering (039) or Computer Science (307).

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
